title: Deterministic Space Is Randomized Space
statement: For every function $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, every language decidable by a deterministic finite Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $s(n)$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$ is also decidable by a randomized finite Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $s(n)$ work-tape cells.
hypotheses_covered: Space bound s from natural numbers to natural numbers
